basic_info.description: Welcome to 2067 Hayes St, a beautifully remodeled top-floor flat in a classic 2-unit building in the heart of NOPA. Transparent Pricing. This spacious 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath TIC combines timeless San Francisco architecture, including high ceilings, with thoughtful modern upgrades, blending comfort and style with effortless grace. A light-filled entry hall opens to an inviting living room with large bay windows and a decorative fireplace, flowing into a formal dining room ideal for hosting and everyday living alike. All 3 bedrooms are quietly positioned at the rear of the flat, offering peaceful retreats overlooking neighborhood gardens. This residence has been significantly refreshed throughout, featuring refinished hardwood floors, new carpet, paint, and designer lighting. The remodeled kitchen offers new cabinetry, quartz countertops, and premium stainless-steel appliances, plus a convenient adjoining laundry & pantry area. Enjoy designated parking.  Perfectly positioned on an inviting residential street dotted with cafes and small businesses, you're just around the corner from the natural beauty of Panhandle Park.
